specification: WWCP POI 3 SPECIFICATION.md (libs/WWCP_POI); documents of test-vectors/runs/csharp-bc3b1bd
description: Documents an implementation must refuse: a document of the run with a JSON patch (RFC 6902, add/replace/remove) applied, a time it is checked at, or a text. "kind" says what is checked; "basis" where the specification says so, or "(proposed)" where it does not say so yet.

vectors.description: The revision of the genesis commit changed: its @id is no longer the digest of its content.
Another @id.
The @id in uppercase hexadecimal digits: identifications are lowercase.
An ETag of a commit in base64: commits write ETags in hex, a reader refuses others.
An ETag digest of a commit in uppercase hex.
A commit without its effectiveTree ETag.
Another JSON-LD context.
An ETag of an algorithm POI does not know.
Another roaming network.

The change set of a commit has the @id of another change set of the run, its commit identified anew: a change set is identified by its content, nobody names another one with its @id (csharp-review 4).
The change set of a commit names another change set of the run, with its ETags, as the one it was rebased from, identified anew by its content: it was not rebased from it (csharp-review 4).
The change set of a commit with one parent without changes, identified anew by its content: it would change nothing.
The change set of a commit with one parent named as the change set of a merge, which only a merge commit has.
Another sequence.
Another previous checkpoint.
Another root of its commits.
A checkpoint of epoch 1 without "epoch": its @id is calculated with it (csharp-review 11).
The name of the network changed, its eTags not: they no longer are those of its content.
One ETag it lists is another.
Another JSON-LD context.
Another position of the commit in the checkpoint.
Another node on the audit path.
Another revision in the leaf.
The proof against another checkpoint.
After every attestation ended (validUntil).
A second before every attestation was signed, the key statement and the certificates valid: an attestation of the future is no attestation now (csharp-review 7).
Against the trust anchor of epoch 1, whose identity keys did not sign the key statement of epoch 2.
An EVSE the proof gives completely changed: the proof leads to another root.
The value of every attestation changed.
Another revision than its attestations name, the commit the same.
Another commit than its attestations name.
Without attestations.
With the attestation of one holder only, where the quorum takes more.
Another price, the signature not.
Another sequence.
Another EVSE.
Another version of the QR code.
The QR code without its last characters.
A character that is no Base45.
